$comment: BLG-001 manifest. `fields` defaults to every public entity field.
notPersisted / notReadBack MUST carry a reason - a bare name fails the audit,
so an exception is always a deliberate, recorded decision rather than a way
to silence the gate. Reasons citing BLG-020 are GENUINE open gaps in the
live repository (see the backlog); reasons citing ANALYZER are known static

notPersisted.enablerId: BLG-020: written only by the dead OrderRepositoryImpl; the live PrismaOrderRepository never persists it. Unverified user impact - needs a functional test.
notPersisted.enablerCode: BLG-020: as enablerId - only the dead repository writes it.
notPersisted.version: BLG-020: optimistic-lock column; the live repository never increments or reads it, so the lock is inert. Only the dead repository writes it.
notPersisted.codReputationScore: BLG-020: only the dead repository writes it.
notPersisted.codEligibilityChecked: BLG-020: only the dead repository writes it.
notPersisted.codDeliveryOtp: BLG-020: only the dead repository writes it. HIGHEST RISK in this set - a COD delivery OTP that is never persisted cannot survive the next read, so COD delivery confirmation is likely broken. Needs a functional test before that is asserted.
notPersisted.codOtpExpiresAt: BLG-020: as codDeliveryOtp - OTP expiry is never persisted.
notPersisted.codDeliveryConfirmedAt: BLG-020: only the dead repository writes it.
notPersisted.codDeliveryConfirmedBy: BLG-020: only the dead repository writes it.
notPersisted.codProofGpsLat: BLG-020: COD proof-of-delivery GPS is only written by the dead repository.
notPersisted.codCommitmentFee: Written by BuyerConfirmCheckoutUseCase via a direct prisma.order_Order.update, not through save(). Intentional - the commitment is set at checkout, not at placement.
notPersisted.codCommitmentPaid: As codCommitmentFee - set by the checkout use case via a direct update.
notPersisted.codCommitmentHoldId: As codCommitmentFee - set by the checkout use case via a direct update.
notPersisted.deliveryCodeUsedAt: Set by the delivery-confirmation path via a direct update, not through save().
notPersisted.cancelReason: Renamed to cancellationReason in the repository; see fieldMap.

notReadBack.enablerId: BLG-020: not mapped on read - unreachable through the repository even if another writer sets it.
notReadBack.version: BLG-020: as enablerId - the optimistic-lock value is never read back.
notReadBack.codDeliveryOtp: BLG-020: as enablerId. HIGHEST RISK - the OTP cannot be read back for verification.
notReadBack.status: ANALYZER: the mapper assigns status through an expression the static pass cannot attribute; it IS mapped. Refine the analyzer rather than keep this exception.
notReadBack.createdAt: ANALYZER: set by imperative post-assignment `(order as any).createdAt = ...` after the returned object literal.
notReadBack.cancelReason: Renamed to cancellationReason in the mapper; see fieldMap.
